name: droneclub-bangladesh
description: Drone Club Bangladesh — corporate website and administration platform

scripts.dev: npm run build:shared && concurrently -n server,client -c blue,magenta "npm run dev --workspace=server" "npm run dev --workspace=client"
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace=shared && npm run build --workspace=server && npm run build --workspace=client
scripts.lint: npm run lint --workspace=server && npm run lint --workspace=client
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspace=shared && npm run typecheck --workspace=server && npm run typecheck --workspace=client
scripts.test: npm run test --workspace=server && npm run test --workspace=client
